cryptoPage.subtitle: Real-time prices and market data powered by CoinGecko, combined with expert trading advice from the Mentix team.

cryptoPage.adviceHeading: Trading Wisdom from the Mentix Team
cryptoPage.adviceSubheading: These principles are battle-tested by professional traders. Apply them consistently to improve your edge.
cryptoPage.tip1Title: Never Risk More Than 2% Per Trade
cryptoPage.tip1Desc: Professional traders protect their capital first. Limit each trade to 1-2% of your total portfolio to survive drawdowns and stay in the game long-term.
cryptoPage.tip2Title: Trade the Structure, Not the News
cryptoPage.tip2Desc: News creates noise. Focus on market structure, key levels, and order flow. Let price action tell you the story - the chart never lies.
cryptoPage.tip3Title: Master Your Emotions Before the Market
cryptoPage.tip3Desc: FOMO and fear are your biggest enemies. Develop a trading plan and follow it religiously. Journal every trade and review your psychology weekly.
cryptoPage.tip4Desc: Always check the higher timeframe for bias, then zoom into the lower timeframe for entries. The weekly sets the trend, the daily confirms, and the 4H/1H provides entries.
cryptoPage.tip5Desc: Do not be greedy. Take partial profits at key levels (TP1, TP2, TP3) and move your stop to breakeven. This secures gains while letting winners run.
cryptoPage.tip6Desc: Smart money hunts liquidity. Look for equal highs/lows, stop hunts, and liquidity sweeps before entering. Trade with the smart money, not against it.
cryptoPage.disclaimerText: This content is for educational and informational purposes only and should not be considered financial advice. Cryptocurrency trading involves significant risk, and you could lose your entire investment. Always do your own research (DYOR) and consult with a qualified financial advisor before making any investment decisions. Past performance does not guarantee future results. performance.title: Trader Performance Analyzer
performance.subtitle: Enter your performance numbers and let the tool reveal your strengths and weaknesses and build a personal development report.
performance.about: This tool doesn't analyze the market — it analyzes the trader. Every trader needs a periodic review every 20–30 trades to find where the real problem is and where the opportunity to improve lies.
performance.currentDDHelper: Enter this value for a more accurate risk analysis
performance.noteBelowBreakeven: Your win rate is below the breakeven for this R:R — the system loses over time. Raise your win rate or your reward-to-risk.
performance.noteHighRisk: Your risk per trade is high relative to your losing streak — a normal losing run could cause a severe drawdown. Consider lowering risk.
performance.noteHealthy: Your numbers show a positive expectancy. Focus on consistency and following your plan trade after trade.

recovery.title: Recovery Analysis Engine
recovery.subtitle: Enter your account data and get a full analysis of your current situation, recovery scenarios, and a practical comeback plan — without recklessness.
recovery.about: Drawdown is a natural part of trading, but the problem starts when a trader tries to recover quickly by increasing risk. This tool helps you see your situation realistically and build an executable recovery plan.
recovery.warnNegative: With these numbers the expected performance is not positive — the account can't realistically recover until the strategy is net positive.
recovery.planHealthy: Keep your risk unchanged and let your edge compound. Avoid raising risk to "catch up" — that's what turns a drawdown into a blown account.

risk.title: Risk System Builder
risk.subtitle: Build a personal risk system that defines your per-trade, daily, weekly, and monthly limits — based on your account and how you actually trade.
risk.about: Risk management isn't one fixed number that fits everyone. The same risk can be fine for one trader and dangerous for another. This tool helps you build limits that fit your account, your number of trades, and your psychological tolerance for losses.
risk.lossTolerance: How many consecutive losses can you handle psychologically without changing your plan?
risk.expectancyNegative: Your win rate and R:R give a negative expectancy — fix the strategy before sizing risk.
risk.note: Never exceed these limits. Hitting your daily loss limit means you stop trading for the day — no exceptions.

plan.title: Trading Plan Builder
plan.subtitle: Turn your goal into a complete trading plan — required growth, risk limits, milestones, and a step-by-step execution plan.
plan.about: Most traders know where they want to get to, but not how to get there. This tool builds the full path for you — not a promise of profits, but a realistic, executable action plan.
plan.edgeReturn: Expected monthly growth with your edge
plan.noteRealistic: Your target is within reach of your edge. Stay consistent and respect your risk limits.
plan.noteAmbitious: Your target is possible but demands near-flawless execution. Consider a longer time frame or a smaller target.
plan.noteUnrealistic: The required monthly growth is far above what your edge produces. Extend the time frame, lower the target, or improve your win rate / R:R.
plan.pressureNoteLow: This plan sits comfortably within your edge. It's sustainable — stay disciplined and let it compound.
plan.pressureNoteModerate: This plan is demanding but achievable. Protect it by respecting your risk limits every single trade.
plan.pressureNoteHigh: This plan is high-pressure relative to your edge. Consider extending the time frame or lowering the target to make it more sustainable.
plan.depositNoteOff: A fixed monthly deposit would lower the growth you need and ease the plan's pressure.
plan.depositNoteOn: Adding {amount} every month lowers your required monthly growth to about {g}%.
plan.alertHighPressure: Your plan needs {g}% growth per month — well above a sustainable pace. A single bad month could throw the whole plan off track.
plan.alertHighRisk: The risk per trade required to hit this target is high ({r}%). That sharply increases your drawdown risk.
plan.alertNegativeEdge: With this win rate and R:R your edge is negative — no risk setting can reach the target. Fix the strategy first.
plan.alertOk: No red flags — this plan is well within a sustainable range for your edge.
plan.actionGuide:
Execution rules:
1. Risk a fixed % per trade — never increase it to "catch up".
2. Stop trading for the day once you hit your daily loss limit.
3. Journal every trade and review your progress at each milestone.
4. Only take setups that match your strategy and your target R:R.
